from_speaker: reflecting the significant cost of running models
our_interpretation: The checkable causal core is that material model-serving costs motivated Microsoft's planned billing change.
Reflecting means a material contributing reason, not necessarily the sole reason.
Significant means large enough to affect pricing or service provision, without imposing a numerical threshold.
The wording also generalizes to any AI product. Evidence concerning Copilot alone cannot establish that full scope.
The importance of the move itself is an evaluative description, not a separately scored factual proposition.
criteria.support_condition: Decision records or direct company explanations establish model-serving costs as a material reason for the change, with evidence adequate to substantiate the claimed breadth across AI products.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Credible decision evidence rules out model-serving costs as a material driver, or reliable product economics contradict the claimed universal scope.
